We therefore use consistency across shadow observations as regularization, encouraging the model to recover scene-consistent appearance while suppressing shadow-specific variations. Global and local consistency further enable us to explore visually related images, learn from imperfectly aligned observations, and focus the representation on shared scene information. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ShadowCLR achieves competitive and often superior performance over state-of-the-art unsupervised methods, demonstrating that consistency can provide regularization for shadow removal without shadow masks or shadow-free images.
summary_zh: 阴影去除是诸多视觉任务的重要预处理步骤，但现有有监督方法需要成对的带阴影图像和无阴影图像，无监督方法通常仍依赖阴影掩码或无阴影参考图像。本文提出ShadowCLR无监督框架，可直接从带阴影图像中学习阴影去除能力。我们的核心观察是：不同观测下的阴影存在差异，但底层场景内容基本保持一致。因此我们将跨带阴影观测的一致性作为正则化项，引导模型恢复场景一致的外观，同时抑制阴影特有的变化。全局和局部一致性进一步支持我们探索视觉相关图像，从未完全对齐的观测中学习，让表示聚焦于共享的场景信息。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，ShadowCLR性能与当前最优无监督方法相当甚至更优，证明无需阴影掩码或无阴影图像，一致性即可为阴影去除提供有效正则化。

title: Improved Automatic Target Recognition in Synthetic Aperture Sonar Imagery Using Large Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: 基于大型深度神经网络的合成孔径声呐图像自动目标识别性能提升
authors: C.J. Moore, Alex Hurt, Jordan Malof
abstract: Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) in Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS) is a task largely dominated by deep neural networks (DNNs). Most SAS-ATR models use convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures whereas transformer-based architectures have had much less representation in the literature despite being state of the art in general computer vision (CV) research. Additionally, researchers have had mixed results in attempting to overcome challenges presented by a scarcity of labeled training data by using methods such as data augmentation and the use of pretrained weights from a variety of imaging modalities. In this work, we compare the performance of modern CNN and transformer-based DNNs to determine which architecture and training configurations elicit the highest performance in SAS-ATR. We investigate how network size, architecture, pretraining method, data augmentation and other forms of regularization affect SAS-ATR performance with a focus on producing the highest-performing model and providing a roadmap for training state-of-the-art SAS-ATR models.
summary_zh: 合成孔径声呐（SAS）图像的自动目标识别（ATR）任务目前以深度神经网络（DNN）方法为主流。多数SAS-ATR模型采用卷积神经网络（CNN）架构，而尽管Transformer架构在通用计算机视觉研究中已达到最优性能，在SAS-ATR领域的相关研究仍较少。此外，研究人员尝试通过数据增强、使用不同成像模态的预训练权重等方法解决标注训练数据稀缺的问题，但得到的结果参差不齐。本文对比了现代CNN和基于Transformer的DNN的性能，以确定哪种架构和训练配置可在SAS-ATR任务中取得最高性能。我们研究了网络规模、架构、预训练方法、数据增强和其他正则化形式对SAS-ATR性能的影响，目标是构建性能最优的模型，并为训练当前最优SAS-ATR模型提供路线图。

title: Designing Versatile Samples for Learned Trajectory Scoring
title_zh: 面向学习型轨迹评分的通用样本设计
authors: Yaguang Li, Jiaru Zhang, Chuheng Wei, Can Cui, Ziran Wang
abstract: Many current end-to-end driving policies emit a pool of candidate trajectories and select one, which makes selection a separable component: a scorer can be retrained while the planner, its backbone, and its trajectory generator all stay frozen. However, many strong planners concentrate their proposals around safe mode, providing limited supervision near decision boundaries. In this work, we design a training dataset that provides more informative supervision for the scorer. In particular, we construct two generators that perturb the logged human trajectory along the two axes a vehicle can be displaced: laterally toward the drivable boundary and longitudinally toward a leading vehicle. The designed dataset produces more informative positive and negative samples than the base planner's proposal pool. We attach a transformer-based scorer to two frozen generative planners, DiffusionDrive and MeanFuser, and train it on the NAVSIM navtrain dataset. The results of the experiments show that we achieve 90.1 EPDMS on DiffusionDrive and 90.4 EPDMS on MeanFuser when using ResNet-34, with 0.4 and 0.3 EPDMS respectively, from the designed training dataset.
summary_zh: 当前多数端到端驾驶策略会生成一组候选轨迹并从中选择最终输出，这使得轨迹选择成为可分离的独立组件：评分器可单独重新训练，而规划器、其骨干网络和轨迹生成器均可保持冻结。但多数性能优异的规划器生成的候选轨迹都集中在安全模式附近，在决策边界附近提供的监督信息十分有限。本文设计了一种可为评分器提供更具信息量监督的训练数据集。具体而言，我们构建了两个生成器，沿着车辆可位移的两个维度对记录的人类轨迹进行扰动：横向向可行驶边界偏移，纵向向前方车辆偏移。该设计得到的数据集比基础规划器的候选轨迹池可提供更具信息量的正负样本。我们将基于Transformer的评分器连接到两个冻结的生成式规划器DiffusionDrive和MeanFuser上，在NAVSIM navtrain数据集上完成训练。实验结果表明，使用ResNet-34作为骨干网络时，在DiffusionDrive上可达到90.1 EPDMS，在MeanFuser上可达到90.4 EPDMS，相比使用基础规划器数据集训练的结果分别提升了0.4和0.3 EPDMS。

title: DESA-TTA: Dynamic EMA and Source Anchoring for Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: DESA-TTA：面向测试时自适应的动态指数移动平均与源锚定
authors: Atif Belal, Lilian Hollard, Marco Pedersoli, Eric Granger
abstract: Vision-language object detectors (VLODs) achieve strong zero-shot performance but remain vulnerable to distribution shifts during deployment. Mean-teacher methods for test-time adaptation (TTA) can improve robustness by updating a student model using teacher-generated pseudo-labels. However, mean-teacher TTA is highly sensitive to the choice of a fixed exponential moving average (EMA) coefficient for teacher updates, and repeated optimization with noisy pseudo-labels can cause cumulative student drift. We propose Dynamic EMA and Source Anchoring for TTA (DESA-TTA), a low-overhead method that jointly regulates teacher updates and student drift through dynamic temporal averaging and source anchoring. Dynamic temporal averaging estimates teacher uncertainty from pseudo-label confidence and box density and uses it to select a sample-wise EMA coefficient within bounds determined by teacher parameter drift. Source anchoring partially restores the updated student parameters toward their pretrained values, with the anchoring strength increasing according to student drift. Experiments across diverse distribution shifts and two VLOD architectures show consistent improvements over existing TTA methods. On VOC-C, DESA-TTA improves AP$_{50}$ by 14.5 points over zero-shot inference while achieving 55\% higher inference throughput than the previous state-of-the-art TTA method for YOLO-World. Our code:this https URL
summary_zh: 视觉语言目标检测器（VLOD）零样本性能优异，但部署过程中仍易受分布偏移影响。测试时自适应（TTA）领域的均值教师方法可通过教师生成的伪标签更新学生模型，提升模型鲁棒性。但均值教师类TTA方法对教师更新过程中固定指数移动平均（EMA）系数的选择高度敏感，且使用含噪伪标签的反复优化会导致学生模型出现累积漂移。本文提出动态EMA与源锚定TTA方法（DESA-TTA），这是一种低开销方法，通过动态时间平均和源锚定同时约束教师更新过程和学生漂移问题。动态时间平均从伪标签置信度和框密度估计教师不确定性，在教师参数漂移确定的边界范围内选择逐样本EMA系数。源锚定会将更新后的学生参数部分向预训练值恢复，锚定强度随学生漂移程度提升而增大。在多种分布偏移场景和两种VLOD架构上的实验表明，该方法性能相比现有TTA方法有一致提升。在VOC-C数据集上，DESA-TTA相比零样本推理将AP50指标提升了14.5个点，同时推理吞吐量比此前针对YOLO-World的最优TTA方法高55%。代码可从对应https链接获取。

title: Efficient Passive Acoustic Monitoring of Killer Whales Using a Two-Stage Detection and Ecotype Classification Cascade
title_zh: 基于两阶段检测与生态型分类级联的高效虎鲸被动声学监测
authors: Daniela Ruiz, Manuel Castellote, Zhongqi Miao, Carl Chalmers, Bruno Demuro 等 (8 人)
abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring of killer whales is particularly important for conservation of the endangered Southern Resident killer whale population, but requires accurate models that can operate in real time under severe class imbalance and deployment shift. We propose a lightweight ResNet-based two-stage cascade that first detects killer whale vocalizations and then classifies confident detections into five eastern North Pacific ecotypes, abstaining on ambiguous calls. We train and evaluate the pipeline on the DCLDE 2027 dataset, where the detector achieves 0.960 macro-F1 and the classifier 0.958, outperforming frozen Perch 2.0 embeddings on the five-ecotype benchmark. By separating detection from ecotype recognition, the end-to-end cascade improves seven-class macro-F1 from 0.919 for a single-stage model to 0.933, with the largest gain on the rare OKW ecotype. To assess transfer beyond the benchmark, we use active learning to adapt the Stage 1 to the acoustic environment of Puget Sound, WA, increasing killer whale detection F1 from 0.405 to 0.755 on manually verified detection windows. Finally, each stage processes a 3 s window in approximately 1.4 ms on an NVIDIA H100, enabling faster than real time inference. These results demonstrate that the proposed two-stage cascade pipeline enables reliable killer whale detection and classification, adaptation to new acoustic domains, and real-time monitoring for conservation applications.
summary_zh: 虎鲸被动声学监测对濒危南方居留虎鲸种群的保护尤为重要，但该任务需要可在严重类别不平衡和部署域偏移场景下实时运行的高精度模型。本文提出一种基于轻量ResNet的两阶段级联框架，首先检测虎鲸发声，再将置信度高的检测结果分类为5种东太平洋虎鲸生态型，对模糊调用直接弃权。我们在DCLDE 2027数据集上训练和评估该流水线，检测器的宏F1值可达0.960，分类器的宏F1值可达0.958，性能优于在5生态型基准上使用冻结Perch 2.0嵌入的方法。通过将检测与生态型识别分离，该端到端级联将7分类宏F1值从单阶段模型的0.919提升至0.933，在稀有OKW生态型上的性能提升幅度最大。为评估基准之外的迁移能力，我们使用主动学习将第一阶段模型适配到华盛顿州普吉特湾的声学环境中，人工验证检测窗口上的虎鲸检测F1值从0.405提升至0.755。最后，在NVIDIA H100显卡上，每个阶段处理3秒窗口的耗时约为1.4ms，可实现快于实时的推理速度。结果表明，本文提出的两阶段级联流水线可实现可靠的虎鲸检测与分类，支持适配新声学域，可用于面向保护场景的实时监测。

title: CoViT: Instance-Correspondence Contrastive Learning for Vision Transformer
title_zh: CoViT：面向视觉Transformer的实例对应对比学习
authors: Yisen Wang, Zhirong Wu, Limin Wang
abstract: Vision Transformers (ViT) excel in semantic understanding but fail to discriminate between object instances (e.g., identical embeddings for two dogs), limiting their use in instance-level tasks such as object detection and instance segmentation. We propose Contrastive Vision Transformer (CoViT), a self-supervised learning framework that injects instance-awareness into ViT through geometry-guided contrastive learning. CoViT uniquely coordinates ViT's attention maps and embeddings by constructing triplets: (1) Attention-guided masking: Refine multi-head attention via adaptive thresholding and morphological operations to generate instance masks, identifying foreground anchors; (2) Hardest contrastive mining: For each anchor, computing pairwise embedding similarities to select the intra-instance hardest positive (least similar patch within its mask) and inter-instance hardest negative (most similar patch from other instances), with intra-instance regions masked during negative search. These triplets drive a contrastive loss that simultaneously compresses intra-instance variance and expands inter-instance margins, forcing ViT to discern subtle geometric and appearance differences between instances. CoViT consistently achieves stable performance gains of over 2 AP points across multiple instance-level perception tasks by using ViT as backbone architecture. Notably, CoViT requires no extra decoders or labels, demonstrating that a pure ViT can learn instance-aware representations via inherent attention priors and targeted contrastive constraints. Code and models will be released.
summary_zh: 视觉Transformer（ViT）在语义理解任务中表现优异，但无法区分不同的目标实例（例如两只狗会生成完全相同的嵌入），限制了其在目标检测、实例分割等实例级任务中的应用。本文提出对比视觉Transformer（Contrastive Vision Transformer, CoViT），这是一种自监督学习框架，通过几何引导的对比学习为ViT注入实例感知能力。CoViT通过构建三元组样本独特地协调ViT的注意力图与嵌入特征：（1）注意力引导掩码：通过自适应阈值处理与形态学操作优化多头注意力，生成实例掩码以识别前景锚点；（2）最难对比样本挖掘：针对每个锚点，计算成对嵌入相似度，筛选出实例内最难正样本（其掩码内相似度最低的图像块）与实例间最难负样本（来自其他实例的相似度最高的图像块），且在负样本搜索过程中屏蔽实例内区域。这些三元组样本驱动对比损失函数，同时压缩实例内方差并扩大实例间间隔，迫使ViT识别不同实例间细微的几何与外观差异。以ViT作为骨干网络时，CoViT在多个实例级感知任务中稳定实现超过2个AP点的性能提升。值得注意的是，CoViT无需额外解码器或标注，证明纯ViT可通过固有注意力先验与定向对比约束学习到实例感知表征。相关代码与模型将开源发布。

title: Ten Architectures, One Error: Shared Failure Modes in Hyperspectral Classification under Spatially Disjoint Evaluation
title_zh: 十种架构，同一误差：空间分离评估场景下高光谱分类的共有失效模式
authors: Ehsan Faghih, Fatemeh Ashrafi, Marguerite Moore, Zahra Saki
abstract: Hyperspectral image classification still relies heavily on random pixel splits within a single scene. The Salinas dataset, randomly split, is among the most widely used datasets for comparing different architectures. However, under a random split method, a large fraction of test pixels fall immediately adjacent to a training pixel, which inflates reported accuracy. This work introduces a leakage-free evaluation protocol linking spatial separation to the model's receptive field. Applying this protocol across ten different architectures, including classical, spectral, spectral-spatial, transformer, vision-backbone, and state-space families, shows that Macro-F1 drops by 0.147 on average and model rankings change by as many as five places. Furthermore, leakage-free evaluation limits which architectures can be tested on a given benchmark. Since each partition supports patches only within a finite radius, reporting this radius alongside the receptive field is essential for fair comparison. In addition, this study reveals that all ten architectures misclassify largely the same pixels, pointing to a spectral ambiguity in the data that none of them resolves.
summary_zh: 高光谱图像分类目前仍高度依赖单一场景内的随机像素划分方法，经随机划分的Salinas数据集是目前应用最广泛的不同架构对比基准数据集之一。但随机划分方法下，大量测试像素紧邻训练像素，会虚高报告的准确率。本文提出一种无泄漏评估协议，将空间分离度与模型感受野相关联。将该协议应用于包括经典方法、光谱方法、光谱-空间方法、Transformer、视觉骨干网络与状态空间系列在内的十种不同架构后发现，模型的Macro-F1值平均下降0.147，模型排名最多可变动5位。此外，无泄漏评估明确了可在给定基准上测试的架构范围：由于每个分区仅支持有限半径内的图像块，报告该半径与模型感受野是实现公平对比的必要条件。本研究还发现，十种架构的误分类像素高度重合，说明数据中存在所有架构都无法解决的光谱歧义问题。

title: Allocate Before You Embed: Adaptive Visual Input Allocation for Video Embeddings
title_zh: 嵌入前分配：面向视频嵌入的自适应视觉输入分配方法
authors: Song Jin, Zhongtao Jiang, Chenglei Shen, Huanxuan Liao, Haozhe Chi 等 (8 人)
abstract: Large-scale video retrieval requires embedding models to encode long and diverse videos under tight visual-input and inference budgets. Existing methods typically sample a small, fixed set of frames at their original resolution, limiting temporal coverage and ignoring frame importance. Our empirical analysis shows that expanding temporal coverage improves retrieval even under a fixed visual-input budget. Gains are larger when the original per-frame resolution is preserved, highlighting the complementary roles of temporal coverage and spatial fidelity. Motivated by this finding, we propose AllocEmbed, an allocate-then-embed framework that reallocates a fixed visual-input budget across more frames. A lightweight allocator uses low-cost previews to assign frame-wise resolutions before the embedding backbone, preserving more detail where it most benefits retrieval while reducing visual cost elsewhere. We further introduce Retrieval-Driven Policy Optimization (RDPO), which learns the allocator directly from retrieval feedback using a rank-validated similarity gap and a confidence-guided efficiency incentive. Operating entirely before the backbone, AllocEmbed integrates with existing retrieval systems without modifying the embedding model or downstream pipeline. Experiments on the MMEB-V2 V-QA and V-RET tasks and our LongRet benchmark show that AllocEmbed achieves the best overall retrieval performance among the evaluated budget-matched methods and transfers across embedding backbones. Our code is publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 大规模视频检索要求嵌入模型在严格的视觉输入与推理预算约束下编码长且内容多样的视频。现有方法通常以原始分辨率采样少量固定帧，限制了时间覆盖范围且忽略了不同帧的重要性差异。实证分析表明，在固定视觉输入预算下，扩大时间覆盖范围仍可提升检索性能；若保留原始的单帧分辨率，性能增益会进一步提升，证明时间覆盖与空间保真度存在互补作用。受该发现启发，本文提出AllocEmbed，一种先分配后嵌入的框架，可在更多帧之间重新分配固定的视觉输入预算。轻量级分配器在嵌入骨干网络之前使用低成本预览数据为每帧分配分辨率，在对检索最有利的区域保留更多细节，同时降低其他区域的视觉开销。本文进一步提出检索驱动策略优化（Retrieval-Driven Policy Optimization, RDPO），利用经排序验证的相似度间隙与置信度引导的效率激励，直接从检索反馈中学习分配器参数。AllocEmbed完全在骨干网络之前运行，无需修改嵌入模型或下游流水线即可与现有检索系统集成。在MMEB-V2的V-QA、V-RET任务与本文构建的LongRet基准上的实验表明，在预算匹配的方法中，AllocEmbed取得了最优的整体检索性能，且可跨不同嵌入骨干网络迁移。相关代码已公开。

title: MemeCULT-1K: Benchmarking South Asian Cultural Context and Humor Understanding of Multimodal Models
title_zh: MemeCULT-1K：面向多模态模型南亚文化语境与幽默理解能力的基准测试
authors: Tawsif Tashwar Dipto, Mehedi Ahamed, Radib Bin Kabir, Mueeze Al Mushabbir, Mohammed Saidul Islam 等 (8 人)
abstract: Meme understanding goes beyond recognizing visual content or literal text; it requires implicit cultural knowledge and pragmatic inference that most vision-language models still lack. We introduce MemeCULT-1K, a multilingual benchmark of 1,000 South Asian memes in Bengali, English, and Hindi, where each meme is paired with a cultural context note and three human-written explanations, along with a supplementary set of 54 Bengali regional dialect memes. We evaluate thirteen popular Vision Language Models (VLMs) under two settings: meme-only and context-aware. Providing minimal cultural context yields consistent gains across all models and languages: mean SBERT similarity improves from 44.6 to 56.4 (+11.8), BLEURT from 37.3 to 42.3 (+5.0), and LLM-as-a-Judge scores from 2.57 to 3.43 out of 5 (+0.86). Fine-grained error analysis reveals that closed-source models fail mainly on entity and reference misidentification, while open-source models are bottlenecked by broader cultural knowledge gaps, with linguistic and phonological failures proving the most context-resistant across both. These results highlight the difficulty of culturally grounded meme understanding and motivate future work on explicit cultural knowledge integration. Our dataset and code are publicly available at TawsifDipto17/MemeCULT-1K.
summary_zh: 网络梗图（Meme）理解不局限于识别视觉内容或文本字面含义，还需要多数视觉语言模型仍欠缺的隐性文化知识与语用推理能力。本文构建MemeCULT-1K基准数据集，包含1000张使用孟加拉语、英语、印地语的南亚梗图，每张梗图都配有文化语境注释与3个人工撰写的解释，还附带54张孟加拉语方言梗图的补充子集。本文在仅输入梗图、语境感知两种设置下对13款主流视觉语言模型（VLM）进行评估：提供最少的文化语境可在所有模型与所有语言上带来一致的性能提升，平均SBERT相似度从44.6提升至56.4（+11.8），BLEURT得分从37.3提升至42.3（+5.0），LLM-as-a-Judge得分从满分5分下的2.57提升至3.43（+0.86）。细粒度误差分析表明，闭源模型的失效主要源于实体与指代表识错误，开源模型的瓶颈在于文化知识缺口，而两类模型都难以克服语言与语音层面的语境相关失效。上述结果证明了基于文化背景的梗图理解任务的难度，为后续显式集成文化知识的相关研究提供了方向。数据集与代码已开源至TawsifDipto17/MemeCULT-1K仓库。

title: AlphaRAD: Grounded Zero-Shot Classification in Chest Radiology via $α$-Corrected Binary Cross Entropy and Factorized Latent Supervision
title_zh: AlphaRAD：基于α校正二元交叉熵与分解潜在监督的胸部放射学基础零样本分类
authors: Jianzhong You, Yuan Gao, Chris McIntosh
abstract: Vision-Language Pretrained Models (VLPMs) offer a scalable path to open-vocabulary chest radiology understanding, yet two aspects remain underexplored: how structured clinical semantics extracted from medical reports can reduce in-batch noise during contrastive learning, and how cross-modal fusion can be designed to produce more faithful spatial grounding without added complexity. We introduce AlphaRAD, addressing these opportunities through two contributions. First, we construct a large-scale structured medical concept space from medical reports parsed by a Large Language Model for training, thereby mitigating in-batch learning noise and removing heuristic pair matching in contrastive learning, and thus naturally positioning AlphaRAD as a medical concept discriminator trained via $\alpha$-Corrected Binary Cross-Entropy. Second, we propose FLaS (Factorized Latent Supervision), an extremely simple yet effective cross-modal feature fusion module that factorizes VLPM representations into independent subspaces, using dedicated alignment supervision to enhance the expressiveness of spatial grounding without introducing additional model parameters. Through extensive empirical validation, AlphaRAD shows strong zero-shot generalization across diverse chest radiology tasks. Notably, it establishes state-of-the-art average performance across 16 classification benchmarks, while achieving individual state-of-the-art results via distinct gains on 7 grounding/phrase grounding and 3 segmentation datasets.
summary_zh: 视觉语言预训练模型（VLPM）为开放词汇胸部放射学理解提供了可扩展的实现路径，但目前仍有两个方向未得到充分探索：如何利用从医疗报告中提取的结构化临床语义降低对比学习过程中的批次内噪声，以及如何设计跨模态融合模块在不增加复杂度的前提下生成更可靠的空间定位结果。本文提出AlphaRAD方法，从两个层面解决上述问题：第一，利用大语言模型解析医疗报告，构建大规模结构化医疗概念空间用于训练，缓解批次内学习噪声，消除对比学习中的启发式配对操作，最终得到基于α校正二元交叉熵训练的医疗概念判别器；第二，提出分解潜在监督（Factorized Latent Supervision, FLaS）模块，这一极简且高效的跨模态特征融合模块将VLPM表征分解为独立子空间，通过专用对齐监督提升空间定位的表达能力，且无需引入额外模型参数。大量实证验证表明，AlphaRAD在各类胸部放射学任务中表现出极强的零样本泛化能力，尤其在16个分类基准上取得了当前最优的平均性能，同时在7个定位/短语定位数据集与3个分割数据集上均取得了当前最优的单项结果。

title: Swin Meets EfficientNet: Lightweight Architectures for GAN-Based Face Forensics
authors: Sejuti Basu, Ashima Sood, Vijay Kumar, Sahil Sharma
abstract: Modern generative models, such as GANs, diffusion architectures, and autoregressive systems, now produce facial images that are nearly indistinguishable from authentic photographs. This capability makes detecting forged images increasingly difficult, raising serious concerns about identity theft, fraud, and misinformation campaigns. Our research focuses specifically on GAN-generated synthetic faces, which underpin many face-centric deepfakes, and investigates efficient detection approaches using image analysis alone. Existing detection systems rely heavily on either convolutional neural networks (CNNs) or global vision transformers. While CNNs excel at identifying texture-based local features, they struggle with broader contextual understanding. Traditional Vision Transformer (ViT) models can capture long-range structures effectively, but demand substantial computational resources. Our work explores Swin-Transformer-based architectures across three implementations: a compact Swin Transformer trained from the ground up, ImageNet-1K pre-trained Swin-Tiny and Swin-Small models adapted for binary classification, and a novel hybrid combining EfficientNet-B0's convolutional processing with a Swin Transformer backend. We evaluated all models using the 140K Real and Fake Faces dataset, which includes StyleGAN-generated fake faces alongside authentic images from Flickr and DFDC, with balanced splits for training, validation, and testing. The EfficientNetB0+Swin hybrid achieved 99% accuracy and a 99.44% recall on 5,000 test images, outperforming both pure Swin variants and a previous CNN-only baseline on this dataset. Our results suggest that combining hierarchical CNN features with shifted-window self-attention provides an efficient and computationally lightweight method for detecting GAN-generated synthetic faces.

title: SCULPT: Training Edge Vision Models for Post-Training Quantization Readiness
title_zh: Swin与EfficientNet融合：面向基于GAN的人脸伪造检测的轻量架构
authors: Bharadwaj Kavuri, Sourav Babu-PK, Varadhraj Ellapan, Pullarao Maddu, Prasad Deshpande
abstract: Edge vision models are difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware, making low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) attractive. In practice, standard FP32 training often produces heavy-tailed activation distributions whose outliers destabilize activation quantization: preserving the full range wastes quantization bins on rare extremes, while aggressive clipping causes information loss. Existing solutions typically rely on quantization-aware training (QAT), which adds training complexity and bit-width coupling, or advanced PTQ procedures that repair the model after training.We present SCULPT (Statistical Clipping and Uniform Loss for Post-Training), a training-time method that improves PTQ readiness during ordinary FP32 fine-tuning. SCULPT combines a topology-aware activation regularizer that suppresses quantization-hostile skewness and kurtosis with a stable percentile-based clipping mechanism that learns deployment-ready activation bounds. Unlike QAT, SCULPT does not simulate quantization during optimization; unlike post hoc outlier-repair PTQ methods, it does not require runtime activation transformations. The learned clipping bounds can be exported directly into a standard PTQ workflow for low-bit deployment, including INT8 and lower-bit settings such as W4A8.
summary_zh: 当前生成模型（包括GAN、扩散架构与自回归系统）生成的人脸图像已几乎无法与真实照片区分，使得伪造图像检测难度持续上升，引发了关于身份盗用、欺诈与虚假信息传播的严重担忧。本研究聚焦支撑多数人脸深度伪造应用的GAN生成合成人脸，探索仅使用图像分析的高效检测方案。现有检测系统高度依赖卷积神经网络（CNN）或全局视觉Transformer：CNN擅长识别基于纹理的局部特征，但难以实现大范围上下文理解；传统视觉Transformer（ViT）可有效捕捉长距离结构，但需要大量计算资源。本文探索三类基于Swin Transformer的架构实现：从零训练的紧凑型Swin Transformer、经ImageNet-1K预训练后适配二分类任务的Swin-Tiny与Swin-Small模型，以及将EfficientNet-B0的卷积处理能力与Swin Transformer后端相结合的新型混合架构。使用包含StyleGAN生成伪造人脸、Flickr与DFDC真实图像的140K真假人脸数据集对所有模型进行评估，数据集的训练、验证、测试集划分均衡。EfficientNetB0+Swin混合架构在5000张测试图像上取得了99%的准确率与99.44%的召回率，性能优于该数据集上的纯Swin变体与此前仅使用CNN的基线模型。研究结果表明，融合层级CNN特征与移位窗口自注意力的方案可实现高效、计算轻量的GAN生成合成人脸检测。

title: Evidential Deep Learning for Multi-Modal Anti-UAV Detection
title_zh: 面向多模态反无人机检测的证据深度学习
authors: Dmitry Golovchits, Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari, Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag
abstract: Anti-UAV systems increasingly fuse multiple sensors, yet their detection heads provide no per-modality reliability signal. This study evaluates whether evidential deep learning (EDL) heads, Dempster-Shafer (DS) evidence fusion, and uncertainty-driven temporal sensor gating improve anti-UAV detection through a controlled ablation on three benchmarks: thermal tracking (AntiUAV600), RGB-audio-RF classification (TRIDENT), and RGB-IR tracking (MM-UAV). The EDL training objective improves accuracy over retrained sigmoid baselines (+5.9 percentage points in accuracy and a tripled tracker-on-absent rate in E1; +4.8 percentage points in classification accuracy in E2, surviving a clip-clustered bootstrap, p = 0.011) and ranks classification errors substantially better (entropy UAUC approximately 0.94 vs. 0.51). The remaining components do not support their respective hypotheses. DS fusion does not outperform simple probability averaging. Dirichlet vacuity adds no ranking power beyond predictive entropy and inverts at the detection level, where extreme background imbalance causes it to encode class membership rather than error likelihood, a failure also observed for entropy and sigmoid confidence. Temporal gating preserves accuracy only when nearly inactive and yields no realised latency saving on shared-backbone hardware. The benefit of evidential learning therefore arises primarily from its training objective rather than its uncertainty estimate; a crop-level control further localises the detection-level breakdown to anchor-level evaluation rather than the learned representation.
summary_zh: 反无人机系统正越来越多地融合多类传感器，但其检测头无法提供每个模态的可靠性信号。本研究在热成像跟踪（AntiUAV600）、RGB-音频-射频分类（TRIDENT）、RGB-红外跟踪（MM-UAV）三个基准上开展受控消融实验，评估证据深度学习（Evidential Deep Learning, EDL）头、Dempster-Shafer（DS）证据融合与不确定性驱动的时序传感器门控机制对反无人机检测性能的提升效果。实验结果表明，EDL训练目标相比重新训练的sigmoid基线可提升性能：实验1中准确率提升5.9个百分点，不存在目标时的跟踪器误触发率降至原来的1/3；实验2中分类准确率提升4.8个百分点，通过了聚类引导的自举检验（p=0.011），且分类错误排序能力显著提升（基于熵的UAUC约为0.94，基线为0.51）。其余组件的效果未达到预期：DS融合的性能未超过简单概率平均方法；狄拉克空值除了预测熵之外没有额外的排序能力，且在检测场景下出现反转，极端的背景不平衡使其编码的是类别归属而非错误概率，熵与sigmoid置信度也存在同类失效问题；时序门控仅在几乎不生效的前提下保留准确率，在共享骨干网络的硬件上无法实现预期的延迟降低。因此证据学习的性能增益主要来自其训练目标而非不确定性估计；基于裁剪级别的对照实验进一步证明，检测级别的性能瓶颈出现在锚点评估阶段，而非学习得到的表征本身。

title: ZipTok3D: High-Fidelity 3D Tokenization with Compact Token Prefixes
title_zh: ZipTok3D：基于紧凑Token前缀的高保真3D Token化方法
authors: Mingda Lin, Weijie Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Bowen Cui, Yefei He 等 (10 人)
abstract: Compact token sequences are essential for efficient 3D generation. However, existing 3D tokenizers typically organize latent representations either over spatial regions or as fixed-size sets of global tokens, both suffering sharp reconstruction degradation when compressed to extremely low token budgets. In this paper, we present ZipTok3D, a 3D tokenizer designed for high-fidelity reconstruction from extremely short token sequences. Its key idea is to organize object geometry into progressively informative global-token prefixes and unfold these compact representations through iterative decoding. Specifically, nested dropout randomly truncates the latent sequence after encoding during training and requires each retained prefix to reconstruct the complete object, thereby prioritizing essential geometric information in the leading tokens. The decoder then repeatedly applies a parameter-shared Transformer block to recover fine-grained geometry from each prefix without a separate generative sampling stage. With the same token dimension, ZipTok3D achieves reconstruction quality comparable to the 32-token COD-VAE baseline using only one token on ShapeNet and four on TRELLIS, yielding $32\times$ and $8\times$ shorter token sequences, respectively.
summary_zh: 紧凑的Token序列是实现高效3D生成的基础，但现有3D Tokenizer通常将潜在表征组织为空间区域形式或固定大小的全局Token集合，两类方案在压缩到极低Token预算时都会出现重建质量的大幅下降。本文提出ZipTok3D，一种专为从极短Token序列中实现高保真重建设计的3D Tokenizer。其核心思路是将物体几何结构组织为信息逐步递增的全局Token前缀，通过迭代解码展开这些紧凑表征。具体而言，训练阶段采用嵌套dropout操作，在编码完成后随机截断潜在序列，要求每个保留的前缀都能重建完整物体，从而让前序Token优先承载核心几何信息。解码器随后重复应用参数共享的Transformer块，从每个前缀中恢复细粒度几何结构，无需额外的生成采样阶段。在Token维度相同的前提下，ZipTok3D在ShapeNet数据集上仅使用1个Token、在TRELLIS数据集上仅使用4个Token即可达到与32Token基线COD-VAE相当的重建质量，Token序列长度分别缩短32倍与8倍。

title: UAV Thermal Imagery for Inert Ordnance Screening: Multi Campaign Dataset Development,Object Detection, and Practical Recommendations
title_zh: 面向惰性未爆弹药筛查的无人机热成像：多场景数据集构建、目标检测与实践建议
authors: Chad Melton, PhD., Annabelle Kelton
abstract: Unexploded ordnance (UXO) continues to restrict civilian access, agricultural activity, infrastructure recovery, and environmental remediation in contaminated areas around the world. This study created a multi campaign UAV thermal image data set of inert ordnance, developed a labeled image set from collected imagery, tested object detection models, and identified practical considerations for humanitarian mine action and demining applications. Data were collected during four field campaigns in Tennessee under summer and winter conditions using inert mines, munitions, and other ordnance placed in short grass, tall vegetation, gravel, mulch, rock, compost, and compacted surfaces. Thermal imagery was collected under flight altitutes of 33 m and 15 m. The final source inventory contained 5,855 thermal image label pairs, including 918 positive images and 4,937 background images. After retaining all positive images and downsampling background images, the 33 m dataset contained 420 training and 106 validation images, while the 15 m dataset contained 629 training and 157 validation images. YOLOV11l and RT-DETR-R50 algorithms were trained and evaluated to develop an automated candidate detection model. Practical recommendations include collecting thermal and RGB imagery together, incorporating varied surfaces and background only imagery, considering periods following changes in solar exposure, balancing survey coverage against target pixel representation, calibrating models with representative local data, and retaining qualified human review. The intended use is screening and prioritization for follow on technical survey or EOD assessment, and not a standalone clearance.
summary_zh: 未爆弹药（UXO）持续限制着全球污染区域内的民用通行、农业生产、基础设施恢复与环境修复工作。本研究构建了多场景的无人机惰性未爆弹药热成像数据集，基于采集的图像生成标注图像集，测试了目标检测模型，为人道主义排雷与未爆弹药清除应用提出了实践参考方案。数据采集工作在田纳西州的4次野外实验中完成，覆盖夏季与冬季场景，将惰性地雷、弹药与其他未爆弹药放置在短草、高植被、砾石、覆盖物、岩石、堆肥与压实地面等不同表面上，分别在33米与15米飞行高度采集热成像数据。最终原始数据集包含5855对热图像-标注样本，其中918张正样本图像、4937张背景图像。在保留所有正样本并对背景图像下采样后，33米高度数据集包含420张训练图像与106张验证图像，15米高度数据集包含629张训练图像与157张验证图像。本研究训练并评估了YOLOV11l与RT-DETR-R50算法，构建了自动化候选检测模型。提出的实践建议包括：同步采集热成像与RGB图像、纳入多样化表面与仅含背景的图像、选择太阳照射条件变化后的时段开展采集、平衡勘测覆盖范围与目标像素表征、使用代表性本地数据校准模型、保留合格人员的人工复核环节。该方案的预期用途是为后续技术勘测或爆炸物处理评估完成筛查与优先级排序，不可作为独立的清除方案使用。

title: From Visual Cues to Spoken Narration: Rethinking Audio Description
title_zh: 从视觉线索到语音旁白：重新审视音频描述（Audio Description, AD）
authors: Akshita Gupta, Aditya Arora, Federico Tombari, Marcus Rohrbach, Anna Rohrbach
abstract: Audio Description (AD) provides spoken narration of visual events during dialogue gaps, making movies accessible to visually impaired audiences. The problem requires determining both what (which visual event) and when (position for inserting the AD) to narrate, to achieve the best user experience. Prior work has largely reduced the problem to video captioning of pre-segmented video clips, i.e., what is largely predefined and when is ignored entirely. We propose Cue2Narrate, a two-stage pipeline that jointly predicts what and when to narrate in longer untrimmed movie clips. A dual-head audio-visual localizer predicts two temporally distinct windows per AD utterance: a visual cue window and a spoken narration window. A LoRA-adapted VLM then generates concise ADs from the predicted visual evidence, trained with a Description Ranking Loss that ranks captions (negative samples) of the same frames lower than the GT AD. To benchmark this new problem statement, we introduce the LongLSMDC benchmark with up to 8-min movie clips (~6.5min on average). On LongLSMDC, Cue2Narrate outperforms video-only and audio-only localization baselines by 5--12 points in avg. mAP. Under both predicted- and GT-window evaluation, Cue2Narrate improves AD generation over the corresponding fine-tuned base VLM. These results establish the first benchmark for multi-segment AD generation on long-form clips. Data & Code:this https URL
summary_zh: 音频描述（AD）会在对话间隙提供视觉事件的语音旁白，让视障受众也能正常观看电影。该任务需要同时确定旁白内容（对应哪一视觉事件）和旁白时机（插入AD的位置），以实现最优用户体验。现有研究大多将该任务简化为对预先分割好的视频片段做视频字幕生成，即预先定义好旁白内容、完全忽略插入时机的选择问题。本文提出Cue2Narrate两阶段流水线，可在未裁剪的长电影片段中联合预测旁白内容与插入时机。该方法的双音视觉头定位器可为每段AD旁白预测两个时间上独立的窗口：视觉线索窗口和语音旁白窗口；随后经过低秩适配（LoRA）改造的视觉语言模型（VLM）会基于预测得到的视觉证据生成简洁的AD内容，训练过程采用描述排序损失，将同一帧的字幕（负样本）排序在真实AD标注之后。为了给该新任务设定基准，本文构建了LongLSMDC基准数据集，包含最长达8分钟的电影片段（平均时长约6.5分钟）。在LongLSMDC数据集上，Cue2Narrate的平均精度均值（avg. mAP）相比仅视频、仅音频的定位基线方法高出5~12个点。无论是在预测窗口还是真实标注窗口的评测设置下，Cue2Narrate的AD生成效果都优于对应的经过微调的基础视觉语言模型。该研究首次为长片段多段AD生成任务建立了基准。数据与代码见对应链接。

title: FairLens: Benchmarking Fairness in Vision-Language Models for High-Stakes Decision-Making
title_zh: FairLens：面向高风险决策的视觉语言模型公平性基准评测
authors: Vahid Reza Khazaie, Ahmed Y. Radwan, Shaina Raza
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to make decisions from visual inputs. We introduce FAIRLENS, a benchmark and evaluation framework for measuring both the fairness and the validity of VLM responses in three high-stakes domains: hiring, legal, and healthcare. FAIRLENS pairs real face images spanning gender, race, and age groups with closed- and open-ended questions, giving more than 100K image-question pairs per model, and evaluates responses from four complementary views: demographic parity over adverse outcome rates, soundness, demographic association over unsupported roles and statuses, and bias in free-text generation. Soundness is the central validity criterion: a response is sound when it follows the evidence stated in the question and abstains when the image cannot support an answer. Evaluating eight VLMs, we find that the primary failure is unwarranted inference rather than unequal treatment. Models routinely infer qualifications, threat, illness, or professional role from a face instead of abstaining, and the weakest model does so on 99% of the questions its input cannot answer. These failures are most severe in legal and healthcare, where recognizing insufficient evidence matters most, and disparity metrics alone would miss them: parity gaps are small in absolute terms, yet when baseline adverse rates are low the same gap means one demographic group receives adverse labels several times as often as another, and a small gap can equally reflect a model that treats every group unsafely. Bias in free-text responses is only loosely coupled to multiple-choice accuracy, so correct structured answers do not imply safe generation. FAIRLENS shows that fair high-stakes VLM behavior requires similar treatment across groups and refusal to infer high-stakes attributes from appearance, and its question suite transfers to any face corpus with demographic annotations.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用于基于视觉输入的决策场景。本文提出FAIRLENS基准与评测框架，可在招聘、法律、医疗三大高风险领域同时衡量VLM输出结果的公平性与有效性。FAIRLENS将覆盖不同性别、种族、年龄群体的真实人脸图像与封闭式、开放式问题配对，为每个模型生成超过10万组图像-问题对，从四个互补维度评测模型输出：不利结果率的人口统计均等性、输出合理性、非支持角色与身份的人口统计关联性、自由文本生成中的偏见。其中合理性是核心有效性指标：若模型输出符合问题给出的证据、且在图像无法支撑答案时主动拒绝回答，则该输出被判定为合理。本文对8个主流VLM开展评测后发现，模型的主要失效模式是无依据推断而非差别对待：模型经常直接从人脸推断出资质、威胁性、疾病或职业身份，而非主动拒绝回答，表现最差的模型在99%的输入无法回答的问题中都做出了无依据推断。这类失效在法律和医疗场景中最为严重，而这两个场景恰恰是识别证据不足最为关键的领域，仅靠差异指标完全无法发现这类问题：绝对层面的均等差距很小，但在基准不利结果率很低的情况下，同等差距就意味着某一人口群体收到不利标签的频率是其他群体的数倍，且微小差距也可能对应所有群体都被模型不安全对待的情况。自由文本输出中的偏见与多选题准确率的相关性很弱，因此结构化答案正确并不代表生成过程安全。FAIRLENS证明，高风险场景下VLM的公平行为需要满足两个条件：不同群体获得同等待遇、拒绝从外观推断高风险属性，其配套问题集可迁移到任意带人口统计标注的人脸数据集上。

title: FORGE: Forward-Only Test-Time Adaptation for Integer-Only Vision Models on Microcontrollers
title_zh: FORGE：微控制器上纯整数视觉模型的仅前向测试时自适应方法
authors: Muhammad Rehan, Haider Ali, Muhammad Ali Munir, Moaz Amjad
abstract: Vision models deployed on microcontrollers (MCUs) are quantized to integer-only arithmetic and run in inference-only runtimes that do not carry the machinery backpropagation needs: the standard tool for adapting a model to the distribution shift (sensor noise, blur, lighting) it meets in the field. Existing forward-only test-time adaptation (TTA) methods either run only on server- or edge-GPU-class models (not true microcontroller integer execution), or require the batch-normalization (BN) layers that integer deployment fuses away. We present a forward-only TTA method that operates on deployed, BN-folded, integer-only convolutional networks. The key observation is that fusing BN into the preceding convolution, a mandatory step for integer inference, destroys the statistics that normalization-based adaptation relies on. We restore adaptation by re-normalizing each folded convolution's per-channel output to its clean training statistics, using only forward-pass estimates. The method (i) recovers most of gradient-based TENT's accuracy gain (+20.9 vs. +24.9 points) and matches forward-only BN adaptation, while being the only method that runs on a folded integer-only model; (ii) needs to adapt only 3 of 21 layers (selected without seeing the test corruptions) to recover 93% of the benefit; (iii) survives single-sample streaming with a batch-size-scaled momentum; and (iv) generalizes across three datasets (up to 200 classes) and two architectures. We validate bit-exact int8 convolution execution and deploy on an ESP32-S3, where, measured with a Nordic PPK2 power profiler, the forward-only adaptation (a lightweight fp32 recalibration around the int8 convolutions) costs only 8.3 mJ (6.8% of inference energy) and 21.9 ms on the deployed SIMD-optimized model: forward-only adaptation is cheap on a real microcontroller.
summary_zh: 部署在微控制器（MCU）上的视觉模型会被量化为仅支持整数运算的形式，运行在仅推理的运行时环境中，不具备反向传播所需的计算组件——而反向传播是现有模型适配分布偏移（传感器噪声、模糊、光照变化等实际场景中遇到的问题）的标准工具。现有仅前向测试时自适应（TTA）方法要么仅能运行在服务器或边缘GPU级别的模型上（无法在微控制器上实现纯整数执行），要么依赖整数部署过程中已经被融合移除的批归一化（BN）层。本文提出一种仅前向TTA方法，可在已部署、BN层已融合的纯整数卷积网络上运行。核心观察是：将BN层融合到前序卷积层是整数推理的必要步骤，该过程会破坏基于归一化的自适应方法所依赖的统计量。本文仅通过前向传播估计值，将每个融合后的卷积层的逐通道输出重新归一化到其干净训练统计量，以此恢复自适应能力。该方法具备四大特性：（1）可恢复基于梯度的TENT方法90%以上的精度增益（+20.9点对比TENT的+24.9点），性能与仅前向BN自适应方法相当，同时是唯一可在融合后的纯整数模型上运行的方法；（2）仅需适配21层中的3层（无需提前查看测试时的图像损坏情况即可选出），就能恢复93%的自适应收益；（3）通过按批量大小缩放的动量机制支持单样本流式输入场景；（4）在3个数据集（最多200个类别）和2种模型架构上都具备泛化性。本文验证了该方法的位精确int8卷积执行效果，并将其部署到ESP32-S3开发板上，经Nordic PPK2功耗分析仪测量，在SIMD优化后的部署模型上，该仅前向自适应过程（围绕int8卷积的轻量fp32重新校准操作）仅消耗8.3mJ能量（占推理总能耗的6.8%），耗时仅21.9ms，证明仅前向自适应在实际微控制器上的成本极低。

title: Beyond Textual Chain-of-Thought: A Survey on Action-Grounded Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
title_zh: 超越文本思维链：自动驾驶中动作接地推理研究综述
authors: Zhengxu Tang, Xiaozhou Zhang, Guofeng Cui, Ziyu Gong, Zi Wang 等 (13 人)
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning powers generative models by eliciting intermediate steps before producing an answer. In autonomous driving, the answer is a continuous action. Thus its reasoning must share the same spatiotemporal structure as the physical world. This survey studies the resulting shift from textual CoT to action-grounded reasoning. Surveying 171 papers, including 130 method papers and 41 benchmarks, datasets, surveys, and analysis papers, we propose a representation-centered taxonomy that treats the form of the intermediate state as the organizing axis. We systematize the 130 methods into four categories: language-based, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic, and externalized reasoning, further divided into 13 subtypes tied to distinct regions of interests. Our synthesis shows that the open frontier of reasoning in driving agents lies in intermediate representations that can be grounded in the real world, coupled to real-time action, and verified under safety-critical systems. Project page:this https URL.
summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）推理通过在生成答案前输出中间步骤，为生成式模型提供强大的推理能力。在自动驾驶场景中，模型的输出是连续动作，因此其推理过程必须具备与物理世界一致的时空结构。本综述研究了从文本思维链向动作接地推理的范式转变，共梳理171篇相关文献，其中包括130篇方法类论文、41篇基准、数据集、综述与分析类论文，提出了以中间状态形式为核心组织轴的表征分类体系。本文将130种方法系统划分为四大类：基于语言的推理、视觉空间推理、潜动态推理、外部化推理，进一步细分为13个子类，分别对应不同的研究关注点。综合分析表明，自动驾驶智能体推理领域的前沿方向是构建可在真实世界中接地、可与实时动作耦合、可在安全关键系统中完成验证的中间表征。项目主页见对应链接。

title: NeoMME: A Single-Tower Multimodal-Native Multilingual Foundation Encoder for Efficient Fine-Tuning and Inference
title_zh: NeoMME：面向高效微调与推理的单塔原生多模态多语言基础编码器
authors: Aurélien Lac, Tony Wu
abstract: Multimodal models often build on architectures designed for generative vision-language modeling, typically combining separately pretrained vision encoders with causal language models. Visual document retrievers such as ColPali repurpose these models as encoders, carrying over the parameter and compute overhead of a VLM for a non-generative task.We introduce NeoMME, a family of 260M and 800M-parameter Multimodal and Multilingual bidirectional Encoders that process multilingual text and raw image patches in a single bidirectional Transformer encoder. Both models are pretrained from scratch with a masked discrete-diffusion text objective, conditioned on visible image patches for multimodal examples. Both support a 16,384-token context, enough to encode up to two standard 4K UHD images.To demonstrate its downstream capabilities, we fine-tune NeoMME with jointly trained dense and late-interaction heads. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, the resulting NeoMME-Retriever 260M outperforms all evaluated models strictly below 800M parameters with 0.523 nDCG@10, while NeoMME-Retriever 800M reaches 0.556. At a matched 2048x2048 image input size on an NVIDIA L40S, NeoMME-260M encodes pages with about 2x the throughput of ColModernVBERT. Hierarchical token pooling and asymmetric quantization compress late-interaction multimodal document embeddings by 255x while preserving over 95% of baseline nDCG@10. We contribute NeoMME to Hugging Face Transformers and release the pretrained backbone and retrieval-compatible checkpoints under Apache 2.0 atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 现有多模态模型大多基于为生成式视觉语言建模设计的架构构建，通常将分别预训练的视觉编码器与因果语言模型拼接在一起。ColPali这类视觉文档检索器会将这类生成式模型改造为编码器，导致非生成式任务也需要承担VLM带来的参数与计算开销。本文提出NeoMME系列模型，包含参数量为2.6亿和8亿的多模态多语言双向编码器，可在单个双向Transformer编码器中同时处理多语言文本和原始图像块。两个模型均从零开始预训练，采用掩码离散扩散文本目标函数，多模态样本的训练过程以可见图像块为条件。两个模型均支持16384 token的上下文长度，足以编码最多2张标准4K超高清图像。为验证下游任务性能，本文为NeoMME微调了联合训练的稠密交互与晚期交互头。在ViDoRe v3基准上，参数量2.6亿的NeoMME-Retriever取得了0.523的nDCG@10指标，性能超过所有参数量严格低于8亿的参评模型；参数量8亿的NeoMME-Retriever的nDCG@10达到0.556。在NVIDIA L40S显卡上，输入图像尺寸均为2048×2048的条件下，NeoMME-260M编码文档页面的吞吐量是ColModernVBERT的2倍左右。分层token池化与非对称量化技术可将晚期交互多模态文档嵌入的压缩比提升255倍，同时保留超过95%的基准nDCG@10性能。本文已将NeoMME贡献至Hugging Face Transformers库，预训练主干网络和检索兼容的检查点以Apache 2.0协议开源，对应链接见原文。

title: PRISM: An Agentic Multi-Model Architecture for Proactive Safety in Autonomous Transportation Systems
title_zh: PRISM：面向自主交通系统主动安全的智能体多模型架构
authors: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh, Sushanta Das
abstract: Autonomous and intelligent transportation systems operate in complex urban environments where safety depends on interactions among vehicle behavior, environmental conditions, and vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians and cyclists. Most advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) employ reactive mechanisms that activate only after hazards have emerged, a critical limitation underscored by rising VRU fatalities in the United States.This study introduces PRISM (Proactive Risk Intelligence and Safety Management), an agentic multi-model safety architecture that transitions from reactive crash avoidance to proactive, continuous risk management. PRISM employs inverse crash-probability modeling to convert binary crash classifiers into dynamic, interpretable safety scores. Three specialized models addressing trajectory kinematics, environmental risk, and VRU interaction operate concurrently, coordinated by a reasoning layer incorporating reinforcement learning, contextual memory, and feature-level attribution. The system provides graduated safety interventions across four tiers, from silent monitoring to emergency alerts.Unlike rule-based systems with static thresholds, PRISM dynamically adjusts safety parameters in real time. Validated across 1,296 scenarios from three naturalistic driving datasets without dataset-specific retraining, the system yielded a mean safety score of 68 out of 100, classified 77.6% of scenarios as advisory, and flagged a near-miss rate of 3.8%, with 11% of scenarios escalating to intervention or emergency response. Feature attribution consistently identified trajectory risk and VRU proximity as primary safety factors. PRISM provides a unified, interpretable framework for proactive transportation safety with emphasis on VRU risk reduction in dense urban environments.
summary_zh: 自主智能交通系统运行在复杂城市环境中，其安全性取决于车辆行为、环境条件、弱势道路使用者（VRU，如行人和骑行者）之间的交互。现有大多数高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）采用反应式机制，仅在危险出现后才触发干预，美国逐年上升的VRU死亡事故数据凸显了该机制的核心缺陷。本研究提出PRISM（主动风险智能与安全管理，Proactive Risk Intelligence and Safety Management）智能体多模型安全架构，将传统的反应式碰撞规避模式转变为主动、持续的风险管理模式。PRISM采用逆碰撞概率建模方法，将二分类碰撞分类器转换为动态、可解释的安全分数。三个分别针对轨迹运动学、环境风险、VRU交互的专用模型并行运行，由融合了强化学习、上下文记忆、特征级归因的推理层统一协调。系统可提供四级梯度安全干预，从静默监测到紧急警报逐级升级。不同于采用静态阈值的规则类系统，PRISM可实时动态调整安全参数。本文在来自3个自然驾驶数据集的1296个场景上完成验证，无需针对特定数据集重新训练，系统的平均安全得分为68分（满分100），将77.6%的场景归类为提示级场景，预警的险肇事故率为3.8%，11%的场景会升级到干预或紧急响应级别。特征归因结果一致表明，轨迹风险和VRU距离是影响安全的核心因素。PRISM为主动交通安全提供了统一的可解释框架，重点面向密集城市环境下的VRU风险降低需求。

title: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
title_zh: 面向可信自主机器人：基于可解释人工智能的决策框架
authors: Cagri Temel
abstract: Autonomous robots powered by deep learning face a fundamental auditability challenge: when incidents occur, investigators cannot reconstruct why the system made specific decisions. This paper presents TRACE (Transparent Reasoning Architecture for Credible Execution), a decision framework that ensures every autonomous action can be traced back to sensor evidence through documented causal chains. The framework organizes decision-making into four auditable layers: Semantic Perception for evidence-grounded entity recognition, Belief Reasoning for probabilistic state estimation with causal graphs, Action Synthesis for constraint-aware planning with counterfactual documentation, and Execution Verification for compliance monitoring. TRACE is model-agnostic yet designed to integrate learning-based perception modules (CNNs, transformers) while preserving decision-level auditability. We evaluate the framework using three objective metrics: Evidence Traceability (sensor-to-decision linkage), Decision Reconstructability (post-hoc analysis capability), and Temporal Continuity (audit trail completeness). Experimental evaluation on warehouse robot navigation demonstrates that TRACE achieves 98.6% evidence traceability, 99.0% temporal continuity, and 98.1% decision reconstructability across 500 simulated decision cycles. Post-hoc methods like LIME provide feature attributions but lack the artifact structure needed for decision-level reconstruction. The framework addresses EU AI Act requirements for high-risk system transparency and contributes to Explainable AI for safety-critical autonomous systems.
summary_zh: 基于深度学习的自主机器人面临核心的可审计性挑战：当事故发生时，调查人员无法追溯系统做出特定决策的原因。本文提出TRACE（可信执行透明推理架构，Transparent Reasoning Architecture for Credible Execution）决策框架，可通过可追溯的因果链确保每一项自主动作都能回溯到对应的传感器证据。该框架将决策过程划分为四个可审计层级：语义感知层实现基于证据的实体识别，信念推理层通过因果图完成概率状态估计，动作合成层实现带反事实记录的约束感知规划，执行验证层完成合规性监控。TRACE是模型无关的框架，可在集成基于学习的感知模块（卷积神经网络CNN、Transformer）的同时，保留决策级别的可审计性。本文采用三个客观指标对框架开展评测：证据可追溯性（传感器到决策的关联程度）、决策可重构性（事后分析能力）、时间连续性（审计轨迹的完整性）。在仓库机器人导航任务上的实验结果表明，在500个模拟决策周期中，TRACE实现了98.6%的证据可追溯性、99.0%的时间连续性和98.1%的决策可重构性。LIME这类事后可解释方法虽然可以提供特征归因结果，但缺少决策级重构所需的结构化产物。该框架满足欧盟人工智能法案对高风险系统的透明度要求，为安全关键自主系统的可解释人工智能研究提供支撑。

title: Toward Robust LiDAR Semantic Segmentation for Real-World Deployment: Evaluation under Coarse Labels, Adverse Conditions, and Domain Shifts
title_zh: 更优的假想推演是否意味着更优的机器人控制？反馈条件下世界模型评测的对照研究
authors: Samir Abou Haidar, Alexandre Chariot, Mehdi Darouich, Cyril Joly, Jean-Emmanuel Deschaud
abstract: LiDAR-based semantic segmentation is a core perception module for autonomous vehicles and mobile robots. Despite the strong performance of recent state-of-the-art methods on standard benchmarks, existing evaluation protocols remain focused on clean, single-domain settings and fine-grained label taxonomies, leaving deployment readiness largely unassessed. Real-world systems must handle safety-critical label semantics, degraded sensing conditions, and cross-domain variability, yet no unified protocol currently addresses all three aspects together. In this paper, we propose a structured evaluation protocol that assesses the deployment readiness of LiDAR semantic segmentation models along three complementary dimensions: (i) coarse-label evaluation aligned with autonomous driving safety priorities, revealing how label granularity affects different methods; (ii) robustness under eight types of LiDAR corruptions designed to emulate real-world atmospheric, geometric, and sensor degradations; and (iii) domain generalization across datasets without adaptation. The evaluation includes inference speed measured on an embedded Jetson AGX Orin platform, directly reflecting deployment constraints. Our results show that fine-grained benchmark rankings do not always reflect safety-relevant performance, that all methods experience substantial degradation under corruptions with architecture-dependent robustness characteristics, and that current domain generalization remains insufficient for reliable deployment. These findings expose concrete gaps between benchmark performance and deployment readiness, and provide a reference protocol for more practically grounded evaluation of LiDAR semantic segmentation.
summary_zh: 预测模型在机器人领域被越来越多地用于状态估计、规划、控制和策略评估，但现有方法大多基于固定时间步长下的开环预测准确率来评判模型性能。而在闭环运行场景中，机器人会反复执行动作、接收新的测量值、更新状态估计、重新计算控制量。本文在存在里程计偏差、间歇性地标感知的差速驱动路径跟踪任务中研究二者的差异，通过轨迹重放、20步无测量推演、闭环跟踪三类设置，在24种感知条件下对6种状态估计器开展评测。结果表明，重放位置均方根误差（RMSE）与闭环横向RMSE的相关性远高于推演误差（斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为0.923和0.774），推演指标在24种条件中有18种选出的估计器与闭环最优结果不一致，而重放指标仅在5种条件下出现该问题。本文进一步调整推演步长和测量更新间隔，当推演步长H=20时，每步都有测量的场景下排名一致性为0.916，无测量场景下排名一致性降至0.774。步长-更新间隔网格实验表明，在保留定期校正的前提下，长预测步长仍具备参考价值，而无校正的长推演得到的模型排名会与闭环实际性能产生显著偏差。本文还测试了在更长感知中断场景下训练的循环估计器，该改进在感知退化叠加场景下提升了锚定扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）模型的性能，将GRU-EKF的横向RMSE从1.72m降至1.06m，但该提升在孤立感知中断场景和不同估计器架构上并不具备一致性。上述结果表明，机器人领域的预测模型评测必须同时明确预测步长和测量更新机制，对于带反馈的模型，离线推演的感知和校正模式与闭环运行一致时，评测结果才最具参考价值。代码见对应链接。

title: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
authors: Dharini Raghavan, Amritpal Singh
abstract: Predictive models are increasingly used in robotics for state estimation, planning, control, and policy evaluation, yet they are often judged by open-loop prediction accuracy over a fixed horizon. In closed-loop operation, a robot repeatedly acts, receives new measurements, updates its state estimate, and recomputes control. We study this difference in a differential-drive path-tracking task with biased odometry and intermittent landmark sensing. Six state estimators are evaluated across 24 sensing conditions using trajectory replay, a 20-step measurement-free rollout, and closed-loop tracking. Replay position RMSE correlates more strongly with closed-loop cross-track RMSE than rollout error (Spearman rho = 0.923 vs. 0.774) and selects a different estimator from the closed-loop optimum in 5/24 conditions, compared with 18/24 for the rollout metric. We then vary rollout horizon and measurement-update interval. With H=20, rank agreement decreases from rho = 0.916 with measurements at every step to rho = 0.774 with no measurements. A horizon-update grid shows that long prediction horizons remain informative when regular corrections are retained, whereas long rollouts without correction can produce rankings that differ substantially from closed-loop behavior. We also test recurrent estimators trained on longer sensing outages. This improves the EKF-anchored models under combined sensing degradation, reducing GRU-EKF cross-track RMSE from 1.72 m to 1.06 m, but the gain is not consistent across isolated outages or estimator architectures. These results show that predictive-model evaluation in robotics should specify both prediction horizon and measurement-update schedule. For models used in feedback, offline rollouts are most informative when their sensing and correction pattern reflects closed-loop operation. Code is available atthis https URL

title: From Proxy Learning to Driving Decisions: A Transfer-Based Framework for Evaluating Future-Aware Autonomous Driving Planners
title_zh: 从代理学习到驾驶决策：面向评估未来感知型自动驾驶规划器的迁移框架
authors: Yikai Wu
abstract: Future-aware representations and world models are increasingly used in proposal-based autonomous-driving planners to improve trajectory selection. However, improvements in proxy objectives or restricted subsets are often interpreted as planning gains without verifying proposal ordering, selected trajectories, full-scale utility, and critical driving components. We propose the Proxy-to-Decision Transfer (PDT) Framework, an analysis framework that evaluates when learned future information supports a reliable driving-performance improvement claim. Its Decision-Transfer Decomposition Module localizes value loss through score margins, switch-conditioned utility, and support-versus-selection regret. Its Reliability-Constrained Validation Module requires exact pairing, a minimum meaningful effect, scale-expanded confirmation, safety non-compensation, sequential comparability, and family-level robustness. On a representative future-aware planner evaluated with NAVSIM-v1, component BCE decreases from 0.705 to 0.530 while held selected PDM decreases from 0.963 to 0.961. A separate candidate improves a 512-record prefix by 0.00909, with a scene-bootstrap 95% interval of [0.000744, 0.0177], but its 2048-record and complete-support intervals include zero. A proposal-level replay further confirms the switch-utility decomposition, yet none of 432 screened configurations passes the two-half, two-seed robustness gate. PDT therefore identifies where decision transfer fails or remains indeterminate across proxy, subset, aggregate, and selection evidence.
summary_zh: 未来感知表征和世界模型越来越多地被用于基于候选方案的自动驾驶规划器中，以提升轨迹选择效果。但现有研究经常直接将代理目标或受限子集上的性能提升等同于规划性能提升，并未验证候选方案排序、选中轨迹、全场景效用、核心驾驶组件的实际表现。本文提出代理到决策迁移（PDT）框架，这一分析框架可用于评估学习到的未来信息何时能支撑可靠的驾驶性能提升结论。其决策迁移分解模块可通过分数边距、切换条件效用、支持度-选择后悔值定位价值损失；其可靠性约束验证模块要求满足精确配对、最小有意义效应、全场景扩展确认、安全非补偿、序列可比性、家族级鲁棒性六大条件。在基于NAVSIM-v1评测的代表性未来感知规划器上开展实验，组件二分类交叉熵（BCE）从0.705降至0.530，但保留的选中轨迹PDM指标仅从0.963降至0.961。某候选改进方案在512条记录的前缀集上性能提升0.00909，场景自举95%置信区间为[0.000744, 0.0177]，但在2048条记录和全量支持集上的置信区间包含0。候选方案级重放实验进一步验证了切换效用分解的有效性，但在筛选出的432种配置中，没有任何一种能通过两半集、双种子的鲁棒性校验。PDT框架可有效识别出代理、子集、聚合、选择各维度证据中决策迁移失效或结果不确定的场景。

title: HINT: Human-Intent Inception for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
title_zh: HINT（人类意图初始框架）：面向长时域机器人操作的人类意图初始化方法
authors: Mingyu Mei, Haojie Xu, Shihao Jin, Zibo Dai, Qihao Cheng 等 (12 人)
abstract: Humans can perform complex manipulations given a simple intent through an overall instruction, while continuously adapting to evolving visual observations. However, current vision-language action (VLA) models and other action policies struggle to realize this high-level intelligent behavior under dense, evolving visual inputs and sparse language guidance. Visual correlations can then dominate semantic intent, leading actions to follow visual shortcuts rather than human goals. We present HINT (Human-INTent INcepTion), an agentic framework inspired by the human manipulation principles: semantic intent changes sparsely at manipulation-pattern transitions, whereas continuous control primarily depends on the evolving object-hand relationship. HINT invokes semantic reasoning only at pattern transitions to resolve the current subtask and target, then maintains this commitment through multi-view grounding and visual tracking. We explore two visual interfaces-image-space semantic highlighting and attention-prior injection-to communicate the tracked intent to the action policy without introducing additional trainable parameters into the foundation action model. Experiments across three long-horizon tasks and out-of-distribution variants show that HINT substantially improves intent understanding, task progress, and end-to-end success across two foundation policies while preserving low-latency control.
summary_zh: 人类仅需通过整体指令给出简单意图，即可完成复杂操作，同时持续适配不断变化的视觉观测。但当前的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language Action, VLA）模型及其他动作策略，难以在密集动态视觉输入和稀疏语言引导下实现这类高级智能行为。此时视觉关联关系会占据主导地位，覆盖语义意图，导致动作遵循视觉捷径而非人类预设目标。本文提出HINT（Human-INTent INcepTion）这一智能体框架，其设计灵感来源于人类操作的核心原则：语义意图仅在操作模式切换时发生稀疏变化，而连续控制过程主要依赖不断变化的物体-手部交互关系。HINT仅在模式切换阶段调用语义推理，明确当前子任务与目标，随后通过多视角对齐与视觉跟踪维持该任务承诺。本文探索了两类视觉接口：图像空间语义高亮与注意力先验注入，可将跟踪得到的意图传递给动作策略，无需向基础动作模型中引入额外可训练参数。在3项长时域任务及其分布外变体上开展的实验表明，HINT可在保留低延迟控制特性的前提下，大幅提升两类基础策略的意图理解能力、任务推进效率与端到端成功率。

title: Latent Cluster Analysis for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型的潜空间聚类分析
authors: Theodor Wulff, Sergio Lanza, Tamara Bila, Angelo Cangelosi, Stefan Wermter 等 (6 人)
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are increasingly used in robotics for their ability to ground language and perception into action, yet the internal representations driving their behaviour remain poorly understood. We propose LAVLA, a framework for latent cluster analysis of VLA models, and conduct a layer-wise study of the state-of-the-art GR00T N1.5 model, with particular focus on its action decoder. To better characterise the latent space during action diffusion, we introduce a cross-attention-based embedding-weighting method that amplifies relevant features while suppressing less informative ones. Quantitative evaluation shows that weighted clustering consistently outperforms the baseline. To improve interpretability, we extract human-interpretable concepts for each cluster, linking latent representations to semantic descriptions. Our analysis shows that latent clusters progressively disentangle spatiotemporal and kinematic features, with representations becoming more refined in the middle layers and stabilising toward the output. As such, LAVLA advances the interpretability of language-driven robotic systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可将语言与感知信息映射为动作，在机器人领域的应用日益广泛，但驱动其行为的内部表征机制仍未得到充分阐释。本文提出VLA潜聚类分析框架LAVLA，并对当前最先进的GR00T N1.5模型开展逐层研究，重点聚焦其动作解码器模块。为更好地表征动作扩散过程中的潜空间特征，本文引入基于交叉注意力的嵌入加权方法，可放大相关特征同时抑制低信息量特征。定量评估结果显示，加权聚类的性能始终优于基线方法。为提升模型可解释性，本文为每个聚类提取人类可理解的概念，将潜表征与语义描述建立关联。分析结果表明，潜聚类可逐步解耦时空特征与运动学特征，中间层的表征精度持续提升，在接近输出层时趋于稳定。综上，LAVLA可有效提升语言驱动机器人系统的可解释性。

title: Advancing Accessible Underwater Robotics: The Mini-Girona I-AUV at RAMI 2025
title_zh: 推进易用型水下机器人发展：RAMI 2025赛事中的Mini-Girona干预型自主水下航行器
authors: Taqi Hamoda, Bilal Ahmed, Deborah Ele-Ojo, Thi Tran Ha Bao, Adel Saidani 等 (12 人)
abstract: The Mini-Girona Intervention Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (I-AUV) represents an advancement in accessible underwater robotics, designed to bridge the gap between costly, specialized research AUVs and basic Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs). Developed with a focus on affordability and usability, the Mini-Girona, priced at approximately $50,000, integrates advanced components such as a 5-DOF manipulator arm, stereo vision, and AI-driven processing for autonomous navigation and intervention tasks. This paper presents the design and development of the Mini-Girona, detailing its performance during the RAMI 2025 student competition. Despite challenges such as thermal management issues and restricted team access, the Mini-Girona achieved second place overall, excelling in vision-based perception and intervention tasks. This work highlights the platform's potential as a tool for underwater robotics research and education, fostering innovation in real-world underwater applications.
summary_zh: Mini-Girona干预型自主水下航行器（Intervention Autonomous Underwater Vehicle, I-AUV）是易用型水下机器人领域的重要进展，旨在填补高价专业研究级自主水下航行器与基础遥控无人潜水器（Remotely Operated Vehicles, ROV）之间的产品空白。该平台以高性价比与易用性为核心设计目标，售价约5万美元，集成了5自由度机械臂、立体视觉系统与AI驱动处理模块，可支持自主导航与干预任务。本文介绍了Mini-Girona的设计与开发流程，详细记录了其在RAMI 2025学生竞赛中的性能表现。尽管面临热管理问题、团队操作权限受限等挑战，Mini-Girona仍凭借在视觉感知与干预任务中的优异表现获得赛事总成绩第二名。该研究证明了该平台作为水下机器人研究与教育工具的潜力，可为真实水下场景的应用创新提供支撑。

title: Pre-Lane-change Signal in Transitional Autonomous Vehicles: Results from Controlled Experiments
title_zh: 过渡型自动驾驶汽车的换道前信号：受控实验结果
authors: Zeyu Mu, Danjue Chen, Abhinav Sharma, George F. List
abstract: This paper investigates how a production transitional autonomous vehicle (tAV) develops and executes mandatory lane-change decisions. Using 150 controlled mandatory lane changes from the NC-tALC experiments, the study examines whether the eventual target gap is observable before lateral movement begins and how the tAV progresses longitudinally from that pre-lane-change state to lane-change start.Signal time (SigT) is defined as an operational pre-lane-change-start reference point. A Firth logistic regression predicts whether the tAV eventually merges in front of or behind its nearest target-lane vehicle using relative position and relative speed at SigT. Longitudinal progression from SigT to lane-change start is then examined separately for in-position and repositioning cases.The traffic state at SigT contains substantial information about eventual target-gap choice and provides meaningful lead time before lateral movement begins. The proposed formulation predicts whether the tAV remains with its current gap or repositions to a neighboring gap by moving forward or dropping back, including cases with longitudinal overlap and ambiguous current-gap geometry. The model achieves an average five-fold cross-validated accuracy of 0.89. Results also provide preliminary evidence that in-position and repositioning cases follow different longitudinal pathways from SigT to lane-change start.These findings support a two-stage conjecture of the observable lane-change process: longitudinal preparation from SigT to lane-change start, followed by lateral maneuver execution. The formulation applies to in-position, repositioning, and longitudinally overlapping cases, and can support lane-change models that distinguish target-gap choice from lateral-onset timing while representing longitudinal preparation before lateral movement begins.
summary_zh: 本文研究量产过渡型自动驾驶车辆（transitional autonomous vehicle, tAV）生成并执行强制换道决策的机制。基于NC-tALC实验采集的150次受控强制换道样本，本研究考察车辆在开始横向移动前是否可观测到最终目标间隙，以及tAV从换道前状态到换道启动阶段的纵向运动演进过程。本文将信号时间（Signal time, SigT）定义为换道启动前的操作参考点，通过Firth逻辑回归模型，利用SigT时刻的相对位置与相对速度，预测tAV最终会在目标车道最近车辆的前方还是后方完成并道。随后分别针对原位换道与重定位换道场景，分析从SigT到换道启动的纵向运动演进规律。研究发现，SigT时刻的交通状态包含大量与最终目标间隙选择相关的信息，可在横向移动启动前提供有效的前置预警时间。本文提出的模型可预测tAV是保持当前间隙还是通过前进或后退重定位到相邻间隙，覆盖纵向重叠、当前间隙几何特征模糊等特殊场景，五折交叉验证平均准确率可达0.89。实验结果还初步证明，原位换道与重定位换道场景从SigT到换道启动遵循不同的纵向运动路径。上述发现支持可观测换道过程的两阶段猜想：第一阶段为从SigT到换道启动的纵向准备阶段，第二阶段为横向机动执行阶段。该模型可适配原位换道、重定位换道、纵向重叠等多类场景，可为区分目标间隙选择与横向启动时机、同时表征横向移动前纵向准备过程的换道模型提供支撑。

title: ZETA: A Controlled Study of Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment VLA Transfer for Tabletop Manipulation
title_zh: ZETA：桌面操作场景下零样本跨本体视觉-语言-动作迁移的对照研究
authors: Mi Yan, Wenhao Zhang, Zhiqi Zhang, Yu Peng, Tangxinyu Wang 等 (17 人)
abstract: Zero-shot generalization to unseen embodiments is important for generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models as robot hardware evolves and task-specific data collection remains costly. However, a systematic understanding of this problem remains limited, in part because the literature lacks a unified zero-shot transfer definition and controlled evaluation settings that isolate embodiment changes from differences in tasks, scenes, or protocols. To address this gap, we first distinguish strict zero-shot transfer, where the target embodiment is absent from all training data, from pretrain-exposed zero-shot transfer, where it appears only during pretraining. We then introduce a controlled benchmark spanning 14 held-out target embodiments across simulation and real-world validation. Within this framework, we conduct a controlled analysis of four factors: state-action representations, pretraining embodiment diversity, auxiliary co-training objectives, and target-embodiment exposure. Experimental results show that local end-effector (EEF) state-action representations, the source embodiment diversity, and auxiliary co-training improve cross-embodiment transfer by around 15, 18, and 7 percentage points, respectively. We further find that adding only 5% target-embodiment data during pretraining improves average target-embodiment progress by 13.4 percentage points, showing that strict and pretrain-exposed zero-shot transfer are distinct and should be reported separately. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for evaluating and improving cross-embodiment VLA transfer in stationary tabletop manipulation with two-finger grippers, while motivating future investigation of broader settings including mobile-base control, dexterous hands, and long-horizon tasks.
summary_zh: 随着机器人硬件迭代、任务专属数据采集成本居高不下，面向未见过的机器人本体实现零样本泛化，对通用型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型而言至关重要。但目前学界对该问题的系统性理解仍较为有限，部分原因是现有研究缺乏统一的零样本迁移定义，也缺少可将本体变化与任务、场景、协议差异完全隔离的对照评估环境。为填补这一空白，本文首先明确两类零样本迁移的差异：严格零样本迁移指目标本体完全未出现在所有训练数据中，预训练暴露型零样本迁移指目标本体仅在预训练阶段出现。随后本文构建了覆盖14个预留目标本体的对照基准，同时支持仿真与真实场景验证。在该框架下，本文对四类影响因素开展对照分析：状态-动作表征、预训练本体多样性、辅助协同训练目标、目标本体暴露程度。实验结果表明，采用局部末端执行器（EEF）状态-动作表征、提升源本体多样性、引入辅助协同训练，可分别将跨本体迁移性能提升约15、18、7个百分点。本文进一步发现，仅在预训练阶段加入5%的目标本体数据，即可将目标场景下的平均任务推进率提升13.4个百分点，证明严格零样本迁移与预训练暴露型零样本迁移属于两类不同的场景，应当分开报告性能指标。上述研究成果可为双指夹爪桌面操作场景下跨本体VLA迁移的评估与优化提供实践指导，同时推动后续研究进一步覆盖移动基座控制、灵巧手、长时域任务等更广泛的场景。

title: World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion for Humanoids on Foothold-Constrained Terrain
title_zh: 足点受限地形下人形机器人基于世界模型增强的视觉运动控制
authors: Yuxi Liu, Lijun Han, Ziming Wang, Ao Zhang, Cong Yang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Foothold-constrained terrain is characterized by sparse, discontinuous, or geometrically restricted feasible foot contacts, as encountered on stepping stones, across gaps, and on narrow stair treads. On such terrain, a single misstep often leaves little room to recover, so policies that base foot-placement decisions primarily on the immediately visible terrain are prone to failure. We ask whether a learned predictive summary of near-future observations and rewards can provide the anticipatory information required in such settings. We present World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion (WM-LOCO), which jointly trains a recurrent world model and a PPO policy. Conditioned on proprioception and a single onboard depth image, the world model produces a predictive recurrent feature that guides the policy, without explicit foothold labels. In simulation, WM-LOCO succeeds on gaps and stepping stones where a matched baseline fails completely, and matches the baseline's success rate on stairs while improving stride efficiency and reducing pelvis acceleration. We deploy the same policy onboard a physical Unitree G1 humanoid using onboard proprioception and a single depth stream; it traverses all three terrain classes with an average success rate of 93.3%.
summary_zh: 足点受限地形的特征是可行足部接触点稀疏、不连续或几何约束强，典型场景包括踏石、间隙、窄台阶等。在这类地形中，单次踏错几乎没有容错空间，因此仅基于当前可见地形生成落足决策的策略极易失效。本文探究基于学习得到的近未来观测与奖励预测摘要，是否可为这类场景提供所需的预判信息。本文提出世界模型增强视觉运动控制框架WM-LOCO，联合训练循环世界模型与近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO）策略。该世界模型以本体感知信息与单张机载深度图像为条件，生成引导策略的预测循环特征，无需显式标注落足点。仿真实验中，WM-LOCO可在基线策略完全失效的间隙与踏石场景下成功通行，在台阶场景下与基线策略成功率持平，同时提升步幅效率、降低骨盆加速度。本文将完全相同的策略部署在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上，仅使用机载本体感知与单路深度流输入，即可顺利通行全部三类地形，平均成功率达93.3%。

title: MS-MEM: Multi-Skill Manipulation-Enhanced Mapping via Uncertainty- and Disturbance-Aware Action Selection
title_zh: MS-MEM：基于不确定性与扰动感知动作选择的多技能操作增强建图
authors: Yitian Shi, Jesper Mücke, Nils Dengler, Sicong Pan, Rania Rayyes 等 (6 人)
abstract: Accurate scene understanding in confined, cluttered spaces such as shelves is essential for service robots, as many everyday tasks require them to locate and retrieve objects reliably. Yet, it remains challenging due to severe occlusions, restricted accessibility, and the need to avoid excessive scene changes. In this paper, we propose Multi-Skill Manipulation-Enhanced Mapping (MS-MEM), an evidential framework for uncertainty-aware mapping that integrates active viewpoint selection, object pushing, and grasping. MS-MEM combines scene-level metric-semantic evidential belief estimators with an uncertainty-aware grasp representation. This representation is learned using a novel full-evidential grasp estimator that models both grasp affordance and orientation uncertainty. In our framework, candidate perception and manipulation actions are evaluated within a unified action selection pipeline using a common information gain criterion. For manipulation actions, we further introduce a collateral disturbance constraint (CDC) that discourages excessive changes to confident regions of the scene belief. This enables MS-MEM to select actions that effectively reduce map uncertainty while limiting collateral scene changes. Experimental results show that, compared with single-skill and unconstrained baselines that ignore scene disturbance, MS-MEM achieves higher mapping accuracy while substantially reducing scene disturbance, highlighting the synergistic effects of active viewpoint selection, push, and grasp actions.
summary_zh: 对于服务机器人而言，在货架这类封闭、杂乱空间中实现精准的场景理解至关重要，因为大量日常任务都要求机器人可靠定位并取回目标物体。但严重遮挡、可达性受限、需避免场景过度变化等问题，仍给该场景下的建图带来巨大挑战。本文提出多技能操作增强建图框架MS-MEM，这是一套面向不确定性感知建图的证据推理框架，集成了主动视角选择、物体推送与抓取三类能力。MS-MEM将场景级度量-语义证据置信度估计器与不确定性感知抓取表征相结合，该表征通过全新的全证据抓取估计器学习得到，可同时对抓取可及性与姿态不确定性建模。在本文框架中，所有候选感知与操作动作都在统一的动作选择流水线中通过共同的信息增益准则完成评估。针对操作动作，本文进一步引入附带扰动约束（collateral disturbance constraint, CDC），避免对场景置信度较高的区域造成过度改动。该机制可让MS-MEM选择既能有效降低地图不确定性、又能限制附带场景改动的动作。实验结果表明，与忽略场景扰动的单技能基线、无约束基线相比，MS-MEM可实现更高的建图精度，同时大幅降低场景扰动程度，充分验证了主动视角选择、推送、抓取三类动作的协同增益效果。

title: An Adaptive Control Architecture for Slope and Terrain Compensation in Autonomous Navigation in Mediterranean Greenhouses
title_zh: 面向地中海温室自主导航的坡度与地形补偿自适应控制架构
authors: Fernando Cañadas-Aránega, Dirk Wollherr, José L. Guzmán, José C. Moreno, José L. Blanco-Claraco
abstract: The ability to move stably over terrain with varying slopes and textures is essential for mobile agricultural robots operating in complex and dynamic environments such as greenhouses, where small terrain irregularities can lead to significant navigation errors. This article presents a novel terrain-adaptation strategy based on the carried payload, ensuring accurate and robust trajectory tracking. The proposed approach is based on: (i) the experimental characterization of the most common types of greenhouse soil, concrete, compacted sand, and gravel, and (ii) the direct measurement of terrain slope using the IMU, in order to estimate the force with which this angle affects the motor input. Based on this information, a cascade trajectory-tracking scheme has been designed, consisting of a model-based predictive controller (MPC) in the outer loop and a PI controller in the inner loop. The system incorporates an adaptive feedforward control through gain scheduling approach, capable of adjusting to disturbances caused by variations in slope and terrain type. Simulation results demonstrate that the differential-drive robot achieves a significant improvement both in error indices and in control signal efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 在温室这类复杂动态环境中运行的农业移动机器人，必须具备在坡度与纹理多变的地形上稳定移动的能力，微小的地形不规则都可能引发严重的导航误差。本文提出一种基于承载负载的全新地形自适应策略，可实现精准鲁棒的轨迹跟踪。该方法的核心设计包括两部分：（1）对温室最常见的四类地面（土壤、混凝土、压实沙土、砾石）开展实验特性表征；（2）通过惯性测量单元（IMU）直接测量地形坡度，估算坡度对电机输入的作用力影响。基于上述信息，本文设计了级联轨迹跟踪方案，外环为基于模型的预测控制器（model-based predictive controller, MPC），内环为PI控制器。该系统引入基于增益调度的自适应前馈控制机制，可自适应补偿坡度与地形类型变化带来的扰动。仿真结果表明，该差速驱动机器人的误差指标与控制信号效率均得到显著提升，充分验证了所提方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: WildFab: Multi-Axis 3D Printing from Models in the Wild
title_zh: 辅助护理场景下富含接触的人机交互的物理一致性基准测试集
authors: Jiasheng Qu, Zhikai Shen, Chenyu Xu, Hailin Sun, Chengkai Dai 等 (9 人)
abstract: Multi-axis 3D printing enables support-free fabrication and improved part quality, but robustly processing real-world geometries remains challenging. Models from design workflows or direct data acquisition often contain solid--shell combinations and non-manifold structures. Handling such models in the wild typically requires time-consuming geometry repair, which may alter the intended geometry. In this work, we present WildFab, a computational framework for multi-axis 3D printing that directly computes spatial toolpath and global collision-free motion from input models. Our pipeline builds on a hybrid query representation that combines a neural unsigned distance field (UDF) with a regularized generalized winding number field (reg-GWN). The UDF supplies differentiable surface-distance and direction queries, while the reg-GWN resolves near-surface ambiguity in the fitted UDF by providing reliable surface localization and a solid-void indicator. Based on this representation, we introduce a high-precision spatial toolpath computation algorithm that iteratively projects points between optimized guidance-field level sets and reg-GWN gradient-magnitude ridges. Subsequently, we develop an efficient and robust coarse-to-fine collision checking scheme for motion planning: UDF-based rejection first identifies potential collisions, while time-varying reg-GWN verification accurately resolves collision pairs for both solid and shell components. We validate WildFab on diverse inputs, demonstrating successful computation from non-manifold parametric surfaces, voxelized topology-optimization results, implicit models, raw scanned point clouds, and non-watertight meshes. The fabrication results highlight our method's ability to advance end-to-end design-to-3DP workflows.
summary_zh: 传统任务级评估仅判断机器人策略是否完成指定动作，往往会遗漏仅在与人体物理接触过程中才会出现的故障。这类局限性在富含接触的辅助任务中尤为突出，这类场景的有效评估需要具备物理响应能力的虚拟人体、超越任务成功率的交互质量评估体系，以及无信息泄露的观测-评分协议。本文提出面向富含接触的人机交互的物理一致性基准测试集，以机器人辅助洗浴为典型落地场景。该基准集融合了可形变被动响应虚拟人体、兼顾物理合理性评分与任务级成功率的评估体系，以及完全冻结的仅视觉观测/仅评分的评估协议。为保证物理有效性，本文基于Franka阻抗机械臂对医疗护理人体模型的力-压痕测量结果，对各区域的仿真响应完成校准。在采用冻结T1-T7协议、每种方法运行140次的实验设置下，大语言模型增强状态机的任务成功率为72.9%，但经过接触区域正确性与力安全筛选后，有效成功率降至56.4%；VoxPoser生成的接触更轻量稳定，但仅能完成27.9%的试验；零样本pi0.5的任务成功率仅为0.7%，不存在通过接触区域正确性与安全筛选的有效案例。上述结果表明，仅完成任务并不代表接触行为具备物理合理性，在部署富含接触的辅助机器人策略前，必须引入物理合理性筛查环节。

title: A Physics-Consistent Benchmark for Contact-Rich Human-Robot Interaction in Assistive Care
authors: Chengxiao He, Shanghai Yuan, Liuqun Fan, Shenzhen Zhu
abstract: Conventional task-level evaluation asks whether a robot policy completes a specified action, but can miss failures that emerge only during physical human contact. This limitation is critical in contact-rich assistive tasks, where meaningful evaluation requires a physically responsive human, interaction-quality assessment beyond task success, and a leak-free observer-scorer protocol. We introduce a physics-consistent benchmark for contact-rich human-robot interaction, instantiated in robot-assisted bathing. The benchmark combines a deformable, passively responding human, physics-aware scores alongside task-level success, and a frozen vision-only / scorer-only evaluation protocol. To establish physical validity, region-wise simulated responses are calibrated against force-indentation measurements from Franka impedance pushes on a medical-care manikin. Under a frozen T1-T7 protocol with 140 runs per method, an LLM-augmented state machine (State Machine) achieves 72.9% task success but drops to 56.4% after correct-region and force-safety screening; VoxPoser produces lighter and more stable contact but completes only 27.9% of trials; and zero-shot pi0.5 achieves 0.7% task success with no correct-region or safety-gated successes. These results show that task completion alone does not imply physically valid contact and motivate physics-aware screening before deployment of contact-rich assistive robot policies.

title: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
title_zh: 基于习得可停性值的人形机器人安全停机方法
authors: Junfeng Long, Pieter Abbeel, Koushil Sreenath, Roberto Horowitz, Guanya Shi 等 (6 人)
abstract: Humanoid robots responding to emergency stop commands typically execute a fixed maneuver, without reasoning about whether a safe stop is actually feasible from the current state. We cast emergency stopping as a reach-avoid problem and propose Safe-Stop, a task-agnostic framework that pairs a learned stop policy with learned stoppability estimators. The estimators are complementary: a stop-probability estimator supervised by the actual outcomes of the fixed stop policy, and a reach-avoidance estimator supervised by a Hamilton-Jacobi backup over physical state. The first captures emergent stopping behavior of the learned controller; the second provides a complementary recoverability signal. Because the stop policy and estimators do not depend on the behavior policy that preceded the stop command, they transfer across diverse upstream tasks without retraining. At deployment, the two estimates are combined: Safe-Stop commits to the stop only when both estimators indicate that stopping remains feasible, otherwise it hands off to a fall policy, instantiated as a damping fallback. This agreement check yields decisions that are robust without sacrificing reactivity.
summary_zh: 响应急停指令的人形机器人通常执行固定动作，不会从当前状态判断安全停机是否真的可行。本文将紧急停机问题转化为可达避障问题，提出了任务无关框架Safe-Stop（安全停机框架），该框架将学习得到的停机策略与习得可停性估计器配对使用。两类估计器互为补充：一类是由固定停机策略的实际结果监督训练的停机概率估计器，另一类是由物理状态上的Hamilton-Jacobi备份监督训练的可达避障估计器。前者可捕获学习控制器涌现的停机行为，后者可提供互补的可恢复性信号。由于停机策略和估计器不依赖于停机指令下达前的行为策略，无需重新训练即可迁移到多种上游任务中。部署阶段会融合两类估计结果：仅当两个估计器均表明停机可行时，Safe-Stop才会执行停机操作，否则将控制权移交至跌倒策略，该策略以阻尼回退机制实现。这种一致性校验机制可在不降低响应速度的前提下生成鲁棒的决策结果。

title: From Multi-Fisheye Sensing to Panoramic Perception: A Parallax-Aware Onboard Platform for Ultra-Low-Altitude UAVs
title_zh: 从多鱼眼感知到全景感知：面向超低空无人机的视差感知机载平台
authors: Dun Dai, Ze Lu, Cheng He, Yaowen Wang, Quan Quan
abstract: Ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) require surround vision near buildings, vegetation, and other obstacles. We present a parallax-aware onboard platform that converts four synchronized fisheye streams into an open 1280x640 equirectangular panorama (ERP) interface. A purpose-built carbon-fiber airframe integrates the cameras, NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, a flight controller, and a global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receiver. The formation pipeline selects projection depth per overlap and combines controlled seams and photometric fusion. Its accuracy profile adds content-adaptive seam search and a validation-gated residual mesh, whereas its deployed profile retains margin-gated Per-seam updates for sensor-rate operation. Evaluation uses more than 50,000 four-view groups from 18 field sequences. Relative to Fixed Depth, the accuracy profile reduces far-field P90 feature misalignment by 41.6%; the deployed Per-seam profile achieves the lowest aggregate geometric errors across held-out sites. Under a paced 20 Hz replay, the deployed profile sustains 19.99 frames/s at 13.29W mean module-input power. Eight-sector ERP sampling reaches 90.8% mean daytime visual-place-recognition Recall@5. Together, these results validate an integrated onboard panoramic-perception architecture that unifies parallax-aware formation, sensor-rate embedded execution, and reusable downstream vision interfaces for ultra-low-altitude UAVs. The project has been open-sourced atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 超低空无人机（UAV）需要在建筑物、植被及其他障碍物附近获得环绕视野。本文提出一种视差感知机载平台，可将四路同步鱼眼视频流转换为1280×640分辨率的开放式等矩形全景图（ERP）接口。定制碳纤维机身集成了摄像头、NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX计算单元、飞控系统和全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）接收机。该平台的生成流水线会为每个重叠区域选择投影深度，结合受控接缝与光度融合技术实现全景拼接。其精度优化配置新增了内容自适应接缝搜索与校验门控残差网格，部署配置则保留了裕度门控的逐接缝更新机制，可实现传感器速率级的运算。研究使用18个野外序列的5万余组四视图样本开展评估：与固定深度方法相比，精度优化配置将远场P90特征错位率降低了41.6%；部署用逐接缝配置在所有未参与训练的测试场地中取得了最低的整体几何误差。在20Hz的匀速回放条件下，部署配置可维持19.99帧/秒的处理速度，模块平均输入功率仅为13.29W。八路ERP采样的日间视觉地点识别平均Recall@5指标可达90.8%。上述结果共同验证了该集成机载全景感知架构的有效性，其融合了视差感知生成、传感器速率级嵌入式执行能力与可复用下游视觉接口，完全适配超低空无人机的应用需求。该项目代码已开源至对应公开链接。

title: Contact-Constrained Lower-Limb Joint-Offset Calibration for Humanoid Robots
title_zh: 面向人形机器人的接触约束下肢关节偏移校准方法
authors: Kaixiang Lu, Haiyu Lan, Chunxiao Qiao, You Li, Chengyuan Luo 等 (8 人)
abstract: Accurate joint encoder offsets are essential for kinematic consistency in humanoid lower limbs, yet existing calibration methods typically require external motion-capture systems or fiducial targets. We present a self-contained calibration framework exploiting only onboard joint encoders and a pelvis-mounted IMU during static double-support contact.
